basic_info.description: Welcome to 1624 Larkin Street #6, a beautifully updated residence in a boutique 10-unit condominium building, ideally situated in San Francisco's coveted Nob Hill neighborhood. Just steps from vibrant Polk Street, this home offers walkable access to renowned restaurants, charming cafes, eclectic shops and key transit routes. This private, east-facing 3-bedroom/2-bathroom home spans approximately 1,290 square feet and is tucked quietly at the rear of the building. The open-concept living and dining area is spacious and inviting...perfect for entertaining as it flows seamlessly into the modern kitchen featuring stainless steel appliances and a striking stone island centerpiece. Thoughtfully designed with European wide plank white oak hardwood flooring throughout, this home offers excellent separation between bedrooms, ideal for privacy and functionality. Additional highlights include in-home laundry/pantry, ample natural light, and warm, contemporary aesthetic.  Building amenities include elevator, shared rooftop deck with panoramic city views, landscaped rear courtyard with turf/BBQ/seating, one dedicated parking space/attached garage and one storage unit.
